I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the current recorded decision is to hash passwords with argon2id.

The repo itself records nothing about password hashing, so the decision comes from the claude-mem prompt history for this project. That history has two entries on the topic. At 9:29 AM the prompt was "We're using bcrypt". At 9:31 AM the prompt was "argon2id". I took the later one as current and left bcrypt out of the file.

The "argon2id" entry is only a bare word, with no "instead" or "switching to" wording. I read it as a replacement because other pairs in the same history follow the same pattern, for example LFU eviction then "LRU … instead", and openssl then "rustls. better defaults". If you meant argon2id as something other than a replacement for bcrypt, the file needs changing.
